title: Tool row
description: A tool inside an expanded tool set on the Tools page (`.tools-list-toolrow`): name, one-line description and its own enablement switch (or "Always Available" for read-only sets). Indented under its set by its own padding, as the product does.
usage: Direct child of <vsc-customization-list kind="tools">, right after its <vsc-tool-set-item expanded>.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: The set can't be changed (e.g. Copilot's own tools): shows Always Available instead of a switch

states.name: enabled
states.trigger: Click the row or its switch (dispatches toggle with detail.tool).

examples.title: Expanded tool set
examples.html: <vsc-customization-list kind="tools" heading="Tools" description=""><vsc-customization-group label="User" count="1"></vsc-customization-group><vsc-tool-set-item name="Playwright" description="Drive a browser" count="2/3" enabled expanded more></vsc-tool-set-item><vsc-tool-item name="browser_navigate" enabled></vsc-tool-item><vsc-tool-item name="browser_click" enabled></vsc-tool-item><vsc-tool-item name="browser_evaluate"></vsc-tool-item></vsc-customization-list>
